verdict.rationale: Skyfire is an identity and payments layer for AI agents. An agent-commerce platform could plausibly offer background automations such as scheduled or recurring payments or rule-based workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers API keys, KYA/pay tokens, charging, settlement and an MCP server whose tools let the user's own agent find sellers and create tokens. Nothing shows a way to configure automations that Skyfire runs autonomously in the background.
